name: hivesurge
description: Hive Surge: original swarm-lane web game (vertical slice)

scripts.build: node scripts/live-key-guard.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --mode admin && node scripts/live-key-guard.mjs && node scripts/size-budget.mjs && node scripts/admin-split-check.mjs
scripts.build:review: node scripts/live-key-guard.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --outDir dist-review --emptyOutDir && node scripts/live-key-guard.mjs && node scripts/size-budget.mjs dist-review
scripts.review: npm run build:review && npm run serve:review
